svg.title: My Stack
svg.desc: Thirty-two technology marks in rose, lilac, and ice blue, arranged on a compact night-sky panel. Rust, Go, Zig, Bash, C, C++, Kotlin, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Astro, React, Vue, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Three.js, Node.js, Gradle, Android Studio, PyTorch, OpenCV, Git, Docker, Kubernetes, Prometheus, Grafana, PostgreSQL, SQLite, MySQL, Redis.
